snippet.title: DUST: Origins - Gameplay Trailer - WISHLIST NOW!
snippet.description:
!! WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM!! ➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3804800/DUST_Origins

DUST: Origins is an isometric horror shooter set aboard a doomed orbital prison platform, imagined by the creators of Darksiders. Abruptly freed from cryo-prison, you fight to escape a murderer’s row of violent criminals and horrifying monsters before the station tears itself apart.

Join the Discord: http://discord.gg/dustorigins

Escape the station: https://dustorigins.com/
